symptoms: Round brown spots with concentric rings on leaves, often 5 to 10 mm
Yellow halo around spots, spots may join and tear the leaf
Starts on older leaves after boll formation
Premature leaf drop in severe cases

severity_cues.early: Few ringed spots on older leaves
severity_cues.advanced: Spotting across canopy, leaf drop, opened bolls exposed to sun

favorable_conditions: Warm humid weather, cloudy days, nutrient-stressed or ageing crop

treatment.summary: Protective fungicide on schedule plus balanced nutrition, stressed plants spot worse
steps: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP at 2.5 g per litre, repeat every 10 days
Check potash nutrition: deficient plants spot worse
Remove heavily spotted lower leaves off the field
Avoid late irrigation that keeps the canopy wet overnight

products.name: Mancozeb 75 WP
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period on cotton 14 days

products.name: Propiconazole 25 EC
products.label_source: CIB&RC registered label, waiting period on cotton 14 days

organic: Copper oxychloride 50 WP at 2.5 to 3.0 g per litre
Balanced NPK with recommended potash top-up

source.org: ICAR Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR), cotton disease advisory
source.title: Cotton: Alternaria leaf spot management

safety_notes: Wear gloves, mask and full sleeves while spraying
Do not pick cotton within 14 days of spray
